singleAsOfSource.rootCause: GuardrailService evaluated JVM-clock current values while PostgreSQL captured the persisted authority snapshot with statement_timestamp(), permitting effective-dated profile or watermark authority to change between the two instants.
singleAsOfSource.correction: ops.capture_price_authority_snapshot returns one DB evaluation_as_of with the complete snapshot. Metric, diagnosis and price-history reads are bounded by that instant, and GuardrailService compares the evaluated metric entity, fulfillment mode, profile and component identities with the captured snapshot before insert. PostgreSQL rejects a supplied evaluated identity that differs from its exact snapshot.

parameterContract.resolution: Omitted fulfillmentModeCode is valid only with exactly one active mode; multiple active modes require one explicit active mode. UNKNOWN, inactive, invalid syntax and extra keys fail closed.
parameterContract.binding: The selected mode is bound across recommendation, price authority snapshot, Guardrail evaluation, approval, command column/API view, DB currentness predicate and worker row.

findings.rootCause: The earlier closure route had no accepted authority for deferring the listed real-provider, Owner and Gate evidence.
findings.correction: Commit the exact accepted Amendment-002 and acceptance evidence, retain every deferred production boundary in a 17-row machine-readable register, and mutation-test the prohibition on relabeling engineering fixtures as real evidence.
findings.remainingAuthority: Deferred evidence remains production-blocking until the future RELEASE-V1-001 gates named by Amendment-002.

findings.rootCause: AnalyticsCalculationService persisted an hour-aligned period while MetricEngine reconstructed a second now-ending FactWindow, so the query and identity could describe different facts.
findings.correction: AnalyticsCalculationService now owns one aligned half-open FactWindow and passes the same object to activity discovery, every MetricEngine fact query, persistence, diagnosis and digest generation; point queries use the exclusive period end.

findings.rootCause: A non-null aggregate platform-fee total was treated as complete even when an independently applicable category had disappeared. The model had no versioned fee-family applicability contract and therefore could not distinguish applicable-with-value, applicable-explicit-zero, verified-not-applicable and missing/incomplete.
findings.correction: The effective PriceEconomicsProfile now declares every FeeFamily independently. Historical Contribution Profit accepts only complete required families, preserves an explicit sourced zero, accepts verified non-applicability without inventing an amount, and fails closed when any applicable commission, fulfillment/delivery, storage, promotion or other-variable family is removed.

findings.rootCause: Break-even and Minimum Price reused historical average deductions, so a proposed target could cross a percentage/tier boundary or fulfillment mode without changing its projected economics. No exact versioned target-price profile or component identity was bound to the metric.
findings.correction: V0029 defines effective PriceEconomicsProfile authority scoped by platform/account/store/fulfillment-mode/currency/effective range/verification/evidence and fixed, percentage and tiered components. The shared bounded PriceEconomicsCalculator evaluates the proposed target and solves Break-even and Minimum from the same profile/component set; ambiguity, expiry, gaps/overlaps, missing families and invalid/non-monotone ranges fail closed.

findings.rootCause: The proposed-price Guardrail combined historical per-unit metrics with a target price and a persisted freshness value. Its snapshot did not bind the exact profile, fulfillment mode, selected tier/component identities or current feed-watermark authority.
findings.correction: GuardrailService resolves an explicit or uniquely active fulfillment declaration and the exact effective economics profile. Impact Preview, Guardrail and persisted snapshot use the shared target-aware calculator and bind profile id/version/range/evidence, family contract, selected components, eight watermark identities, evaluation instant and ages. DB approval/command/worker gates independently revalidate that current authority.

findings.rootCause: The prior candidate fixed metric identity but still used persisted freshness seconds/event-window recency as write authority. Wall-clock passage, late reconciliation and per-feed omission could therefore leave an old approved decision apparently current without any new metric assertion.
findings.correction: The accepted mutation-sensitive ComputedMetric identity correction is preserved. In addition, DecisionFreshness and source_feed_watermark establish eight attributable feed authorities. Effective reconciled time wins when present, otherwise ingestion time is conservative; preview and every DB-controlled write stage calculate age against its own transaction instant, and an attributed refresh creates a new watermark while never reviving the old snapshot.

findings.rootCause: The designated operating test accepted a blocked Guardrail as an alternate success and later command assertions tolerated refusal; browser fixtures injected the metrics instead of composing the calculator.
findings.correction: OperatingFlowIT now records facts, runs the actual MetricEngine and persistence, evaluates diagnosis and actual Guardrail, approves, and creates a DB-authoritative command with no early-return branch or external write. A same-class defect that marked CLEAR diagnosis rows as blocking was fixed in DiagnosisRepository.
findings.sameClassDefect: currentFindings projected rule.blocks_execution even when finding.outcome was CLEAR; it now blocks only TRIGGERED findings.

findings.rootCause: The permitAll maintenance surface relied on deployment routing; its interceptor checked only mutations and never authenticated the actual socket peer.
findings.correction: AdminMetadataGuard rejects every method unless HttpServletRequest.remoteAddr resolves to loopback, ignores all forwarding headers, then retains the write switch and operator attribution as additional mutation controls.

findings.rootCause: Serving startup required issuer only and a blank audience validator returned success; Terraform and runtime bootstrap also accepted blank audience values.
findings.correction: Every non-local/non-CI environment now requires a bounded nonblank audience; the decoder fails closed if none is configured; staging, production, workload module and packaged bootstrap validate the same shape while local/CI exemptions remain explicit.

findings.rootCause: The infrastructure workflow ran but its stable infrastructure-validation context was absent from protected main's required status checks.
findings.correction: The repository owns an exact 12-context inventory and mutation validator, and live Ruleset 20734984 was updated in place with strictRequiredStatusChecksPolicy=true while preserving every other rule.

codeqlDisposition.title: Missing catch of NumberFormatException
codeqlDisposition.message: Potential uncaught NumberFormatException in numeric remote-address parsing.
codeqlDisposition.correction: Numeric parsing now catches NumberFormatException and fails the loopback check closed.

sameClassScans.scope: analytics calculation and every OperatingFactQuery call
sameClassScans.disposition: One FactWindow is constructed in AnalyticsCalculationService; MetricEngine performs no clock read or window reconstruction; unrelated operational clocks are not calculation identity.

sameClassScans.scope: Guardrail snapshot, metric/diagnosis/history inputs and every effective-dated profile, policy, mapping, component and watermark resolution
sameClassScans.disposition: One PostgreSQL capture supplies evaluation_as_of and the complete snapshot. Application reads use explicit *At methods bounded by that instant; approval, command and worker currentness intentionally use their own later DB transaction instant to preserve aging and mutation closure.

sameClassScans.scope: Guardrail policy, prior price, mapping, mode, economics profile/components and feed watermarks
sameClassScans.disposition: GuardrailRepository parses these values from the one captured snapshot. GuardrailService compares evaluated metric-entity, mode, profile and component identities with it; the DB insert trigger independently requires the exact evaluated-at snapshot.

sameClassScans.scope: every proposed_parameters parser/restriction in Java and PostgreSQL
sameClassScans.disposition: Executable PRICE_CHANGE parameters have exactly required targetPrice, optional fulfillmentModeCode and no extras in RecommendationService, ExecutionService and V0029 functions. The V0024 request-template token parser and AI OutputValidator schema are separate non-executable contracts and were dispositioned without change. V0020 is immutable historical SQL and is replaced by V0029 authority functions.

sameClassScans.scope: API recommendation through snapshot, Guardrail, approval, command and worker
sameClassScans.disposition: Multiple active modes require an explicit active code; the resolved code is stored in the snapshot and guardrail evaluation, copied into ops.price_command.fulfillment_mode_code, returned in PriceCommandView/frontend parsing and selected in the worker repository. Currentness predicates require equality at every stage.

sameClassScans.scope: V0029 wrappers around V0020 snapshot, create-command and worker predicates
sameClassScans.disposition: V0029 replaces the executable snapshot, parameter validator, create-command and authority-match surfaces so no wrapper can fall back to V0020's targetPrice-only restriction or omit the durable mode. V0001-V0028 bytes remain immutable.

sameClassScans.scope: ComputedMetric and persisted Guardrail evaluation identity
sameClassScans.disposition: Metric assertion state/value/currency/confidence/source-time/custom components remain bound. Price decisions additionally bind target, mode, exact profile/version/range/evidence, family contract, selected components and watermark identities; equivalent reruns remain deduplicated.

sameClassScans.scope: profit, fee/tax categorization, Minimum Price and Guardrail economics
sameClassScans.disposition: Each required FeeFamily has an independent applicability/coverage state. Only an attributable explicit zero is zero; verified non-applicability contributes no invented amount and missing/incomplete blocks. Unrelated administrative cardinalities are not commercial facts.

sameClassScans.scope: analytics and price Guardrail arithmetic
sameClassScans.disposition: Historical actuals retain explicit completed-unit denominators and family coverage. Proposed-price Guardrail does not consume historical fee averages; it evaluates the target through the exact fixed/percentage/tier profile.

sameClassScans.scope: Break-even, Minimum Price and Impact Preview
sameClassScans.disposition: All proposed-price paths use PriceEconomicsCalculator with the exact effective profile and target price; historical averages cannot enter projection.

sameClassScans.scope: fixed, percentage, tiered and fulfillment-mode economics
sameClassScans.disposition: Same-tier, higher/lower tier, mode switch and fixed-plus-percentage cases bind the selected component identities; overlap, gap, ambiguity and invalid ranges fail closed.

sameClassScans.scope: historical platform-fee actuals
sameClassScans.disposition: Commission, fulfillment/delivery, storage, promotion and other-variable families are independently removed in unit and actual-service tests; no aggregate can mask a missing required family.

sameClassScans.scope: preview, approval, command creation and worker claim
sameClassScans.disposition: Persisted freshness seconds are descriptive only. Current authority derives from eight attributed source-feed watermarks and transaction-time age; wall-clock aging closes the DB gate without creating a metric row.

sameClassScans.scope: late/reconciled source feeds
sameClassScans.disposition: Reconciled effective time is authoritative when attributed; otherwise ingestion time is conservative. Event-window start or recent unrelated events cannot substitute for a feed watermark.

sameClassScans.scope: Impact Preview through DB worker lease
sameClassScans.disposition: Snapshot creation, approval/command binding and worker dispatch all require the same exact profile/components/watermarks to remain current; refresh creates a new authority and never revives the old snapshot.

sameClassScans.scope: all GuardrailEngine evaluation branches
sameClassScans.disposition: Required policy limits, mapping, diagnosis, all economics and safety metrics, stock, freshness, confidence, currency and standing authorization fail closed with stable reasons.

sameClassScans.scope: OperatingFlowIT and browser/service composition evidence
sameClassScans.disposition: The designated actual-service test contains no early-return acceptance and requires a passing Guardrail, approval and command; synthetic browser fixtures remain only browser behavior evidence.

sameClassScans.scope: /api/v1/admin/metadata/** controller inventory
sameClassScans.disposition: The one path-pattern interceptor covers every current maintenance controller and rejects non-loopback GET/HEAD/OPTIONS and mutations before handlers; server.forward-headers-strategy remains none.

sameClassScans.scope: IdentityProperties, IdentityConfigurationContract, Terraform and runtime bootstrap
sameClassScans.disposition: Serving issuer and audience are mandatory; audience has one 1..255 bounded identifier grammar. jwk-set-uri remains intentionally optional because issuer discovery is the approved alternative.

sameClassScans.scope: .github/workflows and live Ruleset 20734984
sameClassScans.disposition: All 12 stable job contexts, including infrastructure-validation, are present in both the repository inventory and live strict required checks.

sameClassScans.scope: 41-row acceptance status and 17-row Deferred Evidence Register
sameClassScans.disposition: Exactly 17 Amendment-002 rows retain OWNER_ACCEPTED_DEFERRED_TO_RELEASE_V1_001 and validators reject forbidden real-provider/production labels.
